component_donor.meaning: Reuse only part of an asset or visual primitive: pose, silhouette, shading, palette concept, accessory, texture region, effect primitive, particle shape, animation frame, environmental motif.

enhancement_candidate.meaning: Improve an existing Platinum asset/system using donor-derived components or techniques while preserving Platinum identity. Target-level aggregate of component/technique records; resolves to platinum_native + composite.

novel_capability.meaning: A donor reveals a visual/presentation feature Platinum does not currently expose in the same way (e.g. FireRed-style location preview cards built with new Sinnoh artwork). No existing Platinum target is required; a hosting Platinum system is named instead.

novel_detail.meaning: A smaller new visual layer or feedback element that adds information/presentation without replacing an existing system (e.g. temporary PMD-style status indicators above battlers).

reference_only.meaning: Useful for design understanding; not intended for direct implementation.

reject.meaning: No useful visual or technical value for the overhaul.

replacement_candidate.meaning: Whole donor asset is preferable and compatible enough to replace the Platinum equivalent. Valid, but one outcome among several.

technique_donor.meaning: Reuse choreography, timing, palette sequencing, state-machine logic, layering, camera behaviour or animation structure, re-implemented through Platinum-native systems. Never implies donor asset transfer (pixel_use none).

description: Canonical donor OPPORTUNITY classification (selection v3). Replacement is one outcome among eight, not the primary one. This layer is additive: ledgers (role/reason_code), SELECTION_RULES.json and USE_OUTCOMES.json keep their meaning and stay reproducible; this file defines how every donor finding is classified and ordered for implementation.

evidence_basis.catalog_evidence: backed by cataloged donor assets and a committed selection evidence entry (donor.group_ids + evidence refs required; member_digest bound)
evidence_basis.donor_checkout_verification: verified by a targeted, read-only look at a donor checkout at a pinned commit (donor.verification[] lists repo/commit/path/fact); may add a committed render sample under opportunities/evidence/
evidence_basis.prior_session_unrecorded: finding was produced in an earlier session but its evidence artifacts are NOT in this repo. Kept so it is not lost; capped at confidence low and feasibility 1, cannot be human_confirmed, and the queue marks it needs_donor_verification. The donor game is not a cataloged source here.
evidence_basis.repo_document: backed by a committed repository document (refs[] must exist)

feasibility_levels.2: moderate: needs new code/art or partial evidence
feasibility_levels.3: strong: implementable with existing Platinum systems and verified evidence

implementation_order_note: Queue priority within feasibility: novel capability/detail first, then native-implementable techniques, then enhancement, component, and finally direct replacement. reference_only/reject are never queued.

map_existing.comment: How existing machine outputs read in the canonical classes. Derived, never written as findings.
map_existing.replacement_outcomes_note: null = unreviewed for opportunity use (no class assigned, NOT reject). native_keep -> reject only means 'whole asset identical/kept'; a component review may still add findings.

phase_scope: PHASE_SCOPE.json: active analysis is DS-only; GBA/GBC findings are deferred and unranked.
preserved_fields_note: Component/technique/enhancement findings preserve: exact donor source/provenance (donor), intended Platinum target or system (target), what is useful (useful), why (why), compatibility constraints (constraints), adaptation (adaptation), implementation cost/risk (cost, risk), confidence, evidence. Novel capability/detail findings may have target.kind 'none' (no existing Platinum target) and must then name host_system.

ranking.note: Owner ranking order (DS phase): visual impact, novelty to Platinum, feasibility with Platinum-native systems, reuse potential, implementation cost, risk, usefulness as a vertical-slice proof. Each is an integer 1..5 (cost and risk are inverted: 5 = most expensive/risky). rank_score = weighted mean on a 1..5 scale. Explicit findings carry their own scores; ledger/use-record rows use documented profiles (opportunities.PROFILES). reference_only and reject are never ranked.

status.proposed: assessment by tooling/agent; not human approved

target_kinds.asset: an existing Platinum asset (native_ref path + sha256 required)
target_kinds.none: no existing Platinum counterpart (novel capability/detail, reference_only, reject only); host_system names where it would live
target_kinds.system: an existing Platinum system/code path (refs[] must exist in the repo)
